name: Jean M. Ayala
office: City of Baldwin Park, Member of the City Council

items.text: Jean M. Ayala is Mayor Pro-Tem of the Baldwin Park City Council, a seat she was appointed to in 2020 and elected to in 2022. She previously served as the elected city clerk from 2018 and has taught in the Baldwin Park Unified School District for 32 years.

sentences.text: Jean M. Ayala is Mayor Pro-Tem of the Baldwin Park City Council, a seat she was appointed to in 2020 and elected to in 2022.
She previously served as the elected city clerk from 2018 and has taught in the Baldwin Park Unified School District for 32 years.

items.text: In her 2022 campaign, her stated goal was to make the city safer and cleaner, and she expressed concern about trash from the homeless population. At the 2024 State of the City, she highlighted the city’s work safeguarding its financial position to reduce future retirement liabilities and set aside emergency funds. As city clerk in 2019, she certified an ordinance that placed a 3% annual cap on rent increases for certain residential units.
